Starting next month, we'll be implementing a new security
measure at our facility. ® To protect the items people store
in here, we'll be installing scanners at the main gate. All
customers will have to swipe an access card at the gate in
order to get to their storage units. ® This system has the
added benefit of keeping a record of everyone who comes
and goes through the main gate. In fact, we'll all need to obtain
access cards in order to enter and leave. As employees, your
cards will have your photos on them. Please see Hao Nan to
get your picture taken.
